name: python-logging
description: Centralized Python logging: one logging module per project with a call-tracing decorator that logs arguments on entry and the return value on exit.

interface.shortDescription: Add centralized, call-tracing logging to a Python project.
interface.longDescription: Establishes a single centralized logging module per Python project and routes every other module through it. The standard call-tracing decorator records each function's file and qualified name, logs all bound arguments on entry, and logs the return value on exit — nothing else. Forbids ad-hoc log() / log_info() / log_warning() / log_error() helpers redefined in the middle of feature files. Logging is best-effort, idempotent, writes to the repository .log/ directory by default, and never aborts the program.
defaultPrompt: Add centralized call-tracing logging to this Python project.
